description: List the bank holidays (UK, from gov.uk) or public holidays (other countries, from Nager.Date) for a region in a year or between two dates, with weekdays and substitute days. Use it for questions like "When are the bank holidays in Scotland in 2027?". Ranges can be up to three years.

from.description: Start of a date range, instead of year (yyyy-MM-dd).

next_working_day_off.description: Ireland only: true if the person's employer gives the next working day off when a public holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday (the civil service and banks do; Irish law doesn't require it, so the employer may give a day within a month, an extra day's leave or a day's pay instead). Adds those days, e.g. Mon 27 and Tue 28 Dec 2027. Default false.

region.description: Where the person works: england-and-wales, scotland or northern-ireland for UK bank holidays (from gov.uk); IE for Ireland; an Australian state or territory as AU-NSW, AU-VIC, AU-QLD, AU-WA, AU-SA, AU-TAS, AU-ACT or AU-NT (their public holidays differ a lot); US for US federal holidays; or a two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code such as DE or FR for other countries' public holidays (from Nager.Date). Defaults to england-and-wales.

to.description: End of the date range, inclusive (yyyy-MM-dd).

year.description: Calendar year, e.g. 2027. Defaults to this year.

name: get_bank_holidays

attribution.description: Credit to show with the dates

title: Bank holidays
